messages.subject: Executive introduction | Thailand industrial, energy and supply-chain leadership
messages.body:
Dear Peak Recruitment Thailand Team,

Peak's focus on industrial, technology, logistics, supply chain and energy-based executive recruitment aligns closely with my operating background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ year career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring direct experience from a remote industrial operation where energy systems, logistics, government interfaces and stakeholder commitments all affect business continuity. My recent work also includes large-scale solar and battery-storage transition support and carbon-data governance.

I would value consideration for Thailand or APAC mandates in Country Leadership, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability or Strategic Partnerships. I have attached a Peak Recruitment-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
